core_obligations: Set-up (proof lines 2177-2186): shift I past i_0, set B = S = T_{i_0} and replace X, F by pullbacks so X_T = lim X_{T_i}; descend the given quotient F_T -> Q to some F_{T_i} -> Q_i of finite presentation.

Etale-affine reduction (proof lines 2190-2203): surjectivity and flatness over T_i are etale-local, checked on U_{T_i} -> X_{T_i} for the affine etale cover U -> X; this reduces to the algebra problem over A = colim A_i.

Finite-stage conclusion (proof lines 2204-2211): the module-map-property lemma gives surjectivity and the flat-finite-presentation-limit lemma gives flatness over some A_{i'}; hence Q^fp(T) = colim Q^fp(T_i).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a directed system with a base affine T_{i_0} and identify X_T = lim X_{T_i} (proof lines 2177-2182).
Descend the quotient map to a finite stage (proof lines 2183-2189).
Check the two finiteness conditions etale-locally and reduce to the affine algebra problem (proof lines 2190-2203).
Finish with the two Algebra lemmas (proof lines 2204-2211).
